Seasons & Travel Tips

Prepare your baggage with tips regarding climate, gears, and visa norms.

Read Gear Checklist

Best Time to Visit

• Winter (Oct - Mar): Ideal weather countrywide. Highly recommended for sightseeing.
• Summer (Apr - Jun): Perfect season for visiting the Himalayan peaks and hill stations.
• Monsoon (Jul - Sep): Spectacular views of waterfalls and misty valleys in Kerala and Meghalaya.

Seasonal Calendar →

Travel Essentials

• E-Visa: Apply for the official Indian Tourist E-Visa online at least 10 days prior.
• Connectivity: Buy a local 4G/5G eSIM at major airports for seamless navigation.
• UPI/Cash: UPI is universal; however, carry minor cash for rural road stalls and entry tickets.

Travel Tips Portal →

Insurance & Safety

• Medical Insurance: Always buy travel insurance with medical evacuation coverage.
• Water Safety: Drink bottled mineral water; skip ice in road stalls.
• Emergency Numbers: Local police code is 112. Save hotel addresses in offline maps.
